_metadata.title: OpenStack Cloud
_metadata.description: A complete OpenStack cloud environment with tenants, instances, volumes, networks, security groups and floating IPs. Demonstrates marketplace resource management with real backend model scope linking.

user_agreements.content:
# Terms of Service

## 1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing and using Waldur cloud services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

## 2. Service Description

Waldur provides cloud resource management and orchestration services for organizations.

## 3. User Responsibilities

- Maintain account security
- Use resources responsibly
- Comply with applicable laws

## 4. Service Availability

We strive for 99.9% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted service.

## 5. Data Protection

We handle your data according to our Privacy Policy and applicable data protection regulations.

# Privacy Policy

## 1. Information We Collect

- Account information (name, email, organization)
- Usage data and logs
- Technical information

## 2. How We Use Your Information

- Provide and improve services
- Send important notifications
- Ensure security and prevent abuse

## 3. Data Retention

We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services.

## 4. Your Rights

- Access your personal data
- Request data correction
- Request data deletion
- Data portability

## 5. Contact

For privacy-related inquiries, contact privacy@demo.waldur.com
